Evidence

What we hand over, and how we show it

The acceptance criteria we commission against, the records we hand over, the reference lists we use, and the standards work we take part in.

Criteria

Commissioning and acceptance criteria

What "passed" means for each boundary: pressure, cleanliness, approach, flow balance, isolation sequence. Written before the work, not after.

Read →Records

The turnover package

Ten boundaries, three questions each: was it tested, against what, and where is the record. The binder is structured so an operator, an insurer or an auditor can answer them without us in the room.

Read →Reference

Ten leak points

Following the coolant from chip to facility. Not a ranking. A checklist that every liquid-cooling team should be able to score their last project against.

Read →Community

Standards work

Where we contribute language, review drafts and argue about boundaries in public, so that the criteria above are not just ours.

Read →

We do not manufacture components. We take responsibility for the whole thermal path, and we hand over the evidence.
